mistake_reason: Tool Output Misinterpretation (FM-4.2): The Assistant misread the WebSurfer's accurate page output. The visible attribution clearly stated "— Annie Levin, The New York Observer, 7 Mar. 2022", where the standard format is Author, Publication, Date. Instead of extracting the author (Annie Levin), the Assistant applied a flawed parsing heuristic that selected the publication token ("The New York Observer") as the writer, ignoring the clear semantics of the attribution line and the corrective hint from WebSurfer. This is an incorrect interpretation of unambiguous tool output.
